name: APIVALE
description: An OpenAI-compatible gateway advertising introductory credits.
overview: The operator advertises $0.20 automatically at signup without a card to try models including DeepSeek and GLM. Its docs also instruct users to subscribe to a suitable plan, so whether signup credit is usable without a subscription is unclear. Trial expiry, actual credit and model identity were not independently verified.
free_access: No card required according to the operator
Docs mention plan subscription; trial access unclear
notes: Base URL https://apivale.com/v1. Docs also mention subscribing to a plan; verify trial eligibility before relying on it.
